objective: Repair the confirmed numerical/evidence defects, regenerate the data under a corrected protocol with a FRESH unseen test set, run the required 18-row main matrix, and produce an evidence-based report plus a local installable release.

subagents.note: first dispatch (ses_e9f99f0e7ffe7GS2Zmei3ogLAz) returned an empty result and made no changes

last_accepted_result: The 18 required main-matrix rows are trained and evaluated once on the fresh, unseen test split (IC seeds 7001/7002, zero overlap with the development set). All six declared targets are met on the frozen cohort, with the Burgers residual improvement recorded as evaluator-specific.
known_limitations: The learned operators do NOT beat direct numerical stepping on either benchmark (Burgers 0.00054 vs 0.0099-0.0246; Allen-Cahn 0.0027 vs 0.0129-0.0514).

The Burgers residual improvement is evaluator-specific: the declared primary implicit-Euler residual improves ~70%, but the independent centred first-derivative residual is ~45-63% WORSE, and the reference solution is more PDE-consistent than either model under that evaluator.
The peak ALLOCATED memory reduction of ~96% is not a device-memory saving: peak RESERVED memory rises ~9% and total device memory is unchanged.
The physics arm costs rollout accuracy on both PDEs; the overall method recommendation under the global 5% accuracy constraint is data-only.
